title: ranunculus aquatilis f. rigidus
intro: Ranunculus aquatilis f. rigidus, commonly known as American Water Plantain, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the buttercup family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues and skin problems, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include soothing and calming effects, making it useful for treating anxiety and insomnia. Bioactive constituents of American Water Plantain include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
